title: Andre Sandford
intro:
Andre Sandford (Democratic Party) is running for election to the California State Assembly to represent District 18. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
On January 11, 2026, Sandford notified Ballotpedia that he had changed party affiliation from independent to Democratic.
